title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 449  An Act Converting the Bubuan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Sumisip, Province of Basilan, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Bubuan National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Bubuan Barangay tại Thị trấn Sumisip, Tỉnh Basilan thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Bubuan Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bubuan Barangay ในเทศบาล Sumisip จังหวัด Basilan เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bubuan แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Bubuan Barangay di Kotamadya Sumisip, Provinsi Basilan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bubuan Nasional

text.en:
The Bubuan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Sumisip, Province of Basilan, is
converted into a national high school, to be known as the Bubuan National High School.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Bilang 230 for the Ministry of Education, Culture and
Sports intended for new national high schools and an additional amount corresponding to fifty percent of its
share in the budgetary aid actually paid to it before such conversion shall be released for its operation from the
national assistance fund to local schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and
maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
